newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air cargo at Hanover Airport up 12.7pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Air cargo at Hanover Airport up 12.7pct in 1996.

text.p: Air cargo handled at Hanover Airport (HAJ) rose 12.7 percent to 11,247 tonnes in 1996, the airport authority said.
All-freight charter services showed a 12 percent volume rise to 4,658 tonnes, a Flughafen Hannover GmbH statement said.
Belly cargo carried by scheduled airlines Deutsche Lufthansa AG and Hapag Lloyd increased 13.3 percent to 6,589 tonnes.
Passenger numbers grew 4.3 percent to a new record of 4.3 million, including a 14.5 percent rise in intercontinental traffic, the authority added.
